learnings.title: GitHub changelog feed: GitHub Copilot assisted permissions generally available
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog item 2026-10-26-github-copilot-assisted-permissions-generally-available (26 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-28, HTTP 200) states assisted permissions are GA in Copilot CLI (/permissions then assisted), the Copilot app (mode picker, Tool permissions, Assisted) and VS Code (permissions picker, Assisted permissions). When Copilot requests to run a command, access a file system path or open a URL, an LLM evaluates the request; clearly safe requests proceed automatically, others need approval. Enterprise admins can block Allow All while keeping Assisted, disable Assisted separately, and set the default mode for new sessions; if the default is unavailable or prohibited, sessions start with manual approval.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: only relevant if the system plan runs Copilot CLI/app or VS Code agents unattended; Assisted mode still requires human approval for non-safe requests, so it is not a substitute for Allow All in headless automation. No operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Search system scripts and workflows for Copilot CLI invocations and permission mode flags; record found/not-found before 2026-11-04.

learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: Search brands that don't sell on Shopify in the Catalog API (beta)
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog page search-brands-that-don-t-sell-on-shopify-in-the-catalog-api-beta (27 Oct 2026, read 2026-10-28, HTTP 200) states the beta Catalog API search_catalog method accepts a new sources parameter: omit or ["shopify"] for Shopify merchant products only, ["shopify","external"] for both, ["external"] for brands not on Shopify. get_product returns an external product by ID; lookup_catalog support comes later. External products always return eligible.native_checkout false, cannot be bought via Shopify checkout, earn no Promoted Placements commission, and carry description, image, price and a link to the brand's own product page. During the beta external data comes from brand websites and only returns for shoppers in the United States. Existing calls need no change.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: video_shopify needs no change; if it ever uses Catalog API search, keep sources omitted (Shopify-only) unless external links are handled, since external items have no Shopify checkout and are US-shopper only. No operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Search video_shopify code for Catalog API search_catalog / Global Catalog MCP usage; record found/not-found before 2026-11-04.
